text:
maya: Heads up — I'm rolling a small config change to prefix_cache_ttl for staging, want to discuss telemetry gating.

jonathan: thx. what's the plan for exposure/visibility? canary only or staged cohorts?

maya: staged cohorts. Console will have a separate "visibility" toggle for ops vs users. We'll start with 0.1% user exposure but 100% telemetry visibility.

priya: sounds good. need to ensure quota routing respects the new config.

sam: quick Q: does runtime config apply immediately or queued per-region? we've seen propagation lag before.

maya: it's eventual — but console will show per-region apply times. We'll also add a dry-run mode that doesn't affect routing, only simulates.

jonathan: can we add a telemetry gate? i.e. only promote if error rate delta < 0.5% and latency p95 delta < 10ms over 30m window.

priya: yes. we can add a predicate in the rollout API: 

```yaml
rollout_predicate:
  telemetry:
    error_rate_delta_pct: 0.5
    latency_p95_ms: 10
  evaluation_window_mins: 30
```

maya: exact. console will display evaluation metrics and a pass/fail state. toggle to auto-promote if passed.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: preflight metrics query ok, canary cohort created, dry-run logs captured :white_check_mark:

sam: edgecase — if quota throttles during canary due to concurrency, the telemetry may be skewed. we should record throttle_count.

jonathan: good call. include throttle_count and routing-fallback-rate in the predicate.

maya: agreed. updated predicate snippet:

```yaml
rollout_predicate:
  telemetry:
    error_rate_delta_pct: 0.5
    latency_p95_ms: 10
    throttle_count_delta: 50
  routing:
    fallback_rate_pct: 1
  evaluation_window_mins: 30
```

priya: ux question — how do we show this in the console? small panel under rollout showing each metric sparkline + pass/fail

maya: prototype screenshot soon. also adding a 'preview routing plan' that lists which route ids will be affected and their quotas.

jonathan: API debate — should rollout_predicate live on config object or be a separate resource? storing on config makes rollbacks simpler, separate resource better for reuse.

priya: prefer separate resource with id referenced from config. reuse across features.

maya: ok go separate. make sure console UI links to predicate resource and shows version history.

sam: ops runbook: if pass is flaky, we need manual pause and immediate rollback button in console.

maya: yes, adding emergency pause + rollback. also emit audit log with operator id and snapshot of config.

infra-bot: audit-entry created with id a0f3e7 :lock:

jonathan: can we add an opt-in cloak for sensitive configs so telemetry doesn't show raw keys?

maya: we'll mask secrets and show hashed keys. good catch.

priya: timeline — can we ship dry-run + telemetry predicate in 2 sprints?

maya: aim for 2 sprints, but may slip to 3. I'll open a PR for the API design today and tag everyone.

jonathan: lgtm, please include backward-compatible schema and migration plan.

maya: will do. tagging @eng-oncall FYI

sam: thanks all. :thumbsup:
